articles.title: AI searched 100 million possibilities and found a cheaper way to 3D-print a NASA rocket alloy
articles.description: Researchers used AI to search through more than 100 million possible settings for 3D-printing a high-performance NASA alloy. After only 40 experiments, the system identified six successful configurations, including one that worked at a record-low 500 watts. That could allow GRCop-42, currently difficult and expensive to print, to be made with much more widely available equipment.
